metadata.Title: Sample metadata for testing the Graphic Data map figure (https://sanctuaries.noaa.gov)
metadata.Author: Jai Ranganathan
metadata.Dataset: National Marine Sanctuary boundaries plus synthetic Test Points and Test Lines
metadata.Feature Collections: National Marine Sanctuaries (5 polygons); Test Points (63 points); Test Lines (70 lines)
metadata.Coordinate System: WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) longitude and latitude in decimal degrees
metadata.Sanctuary Fields: name; code; slug; source_features; area_km2 (square kilometers); area_sqmi (square miles)
metadata.Test Data: Test Points and Test Lines are dummy features placed 0-20 miles off the California coast; their attribute values are placeholders

features.name: Test Points
features.description: Synthetic test data: 100 points 0-20 miles off the US west coast.

features.name: Test Lines
features.description: Synthetic test data: 100 lines 0-20 miles off the US west coast.
